_source: Illustrative starting setup (everything made in China) built from the facts of CBP ruling N347615 (5 May 2025), where the wrench is forged in Vietnam and machined, heat-treated and assembled in China: CBP held Vietnam. The all-China setup has no ruling; the engine predicts its origin. N347615 is in the selection pool and is excluded.

product.name: Reversible ratcheting wrench
product.description: A box-end wrench made primarily of steel whose two box ends hold a ratcheting mechanism of plastic and metal parts.

components.name: springs, clips, pins and small bushings of the ratcheting mechanism

operations.name: cut raw steel rods to length and forge them into the final size, shape and form of the wrench, except the two end holes
machine the two end holes, heat-treat and polish
assemble the ratcheting mechanism into the end holes and pack
